name: Data.TameChar.IsIntegralMeasure.norm_apply_one_le
summary: F(1) = ∑ c_α is a sum of l-integral numbers (the trivial character has empty modulus, so every l is prime to it).

steps.claim: F(1) = ∑_α c_α·1(u_α) = ∑_α c_α; each c_α is integral at l (the modulus of the trivial character is empty, so l is prime to its norm, `twist_one_spec`), so ι(F(1)) lies in the valuation ring (`embValRing`) and |ι(F(1))| ≤ 1.
steps.lean:
(ι : ℂ ≃+* PadicAlgCl l) : (@one P D).IsIntegralMeasure F → ‖ι (F one)‖ ≤ 1 := fun ⟨_, _, _, _, a,
  b⟩ ↦ by simpa [b, twist_one_spec, ← map_sum] using!
    ((@embValRing l _ ⟨complexToCp ι⟩).sum_mem fun _ _ ↦
  a _ l (by simp [levelNorm, twist_one_spec]) (complexToCp ι))
